Name: FINAL_DAMAGE_RATE_PARAM_ST
Description: PvP damage multipliers. Picked by the attack's AtkParam Final Damage Rate ID (-1 or a missing row: no change) and applied only when both the attacker and the target are player characters.

Fields.Name: Damage Multiplier: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplies the physical damage dealt in PvP. 1: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Damage Multiplier: Magic
Fields.Description: Multiplies the magic damage dealt in PvP. 1: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Damage Multiplier: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplies the fire damage dealt in PvP. 1: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Damage Multiplier: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplies the lightning damage dealt in PvP. 1: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Damage Multiplier: Holy
Fields.Description: Multiplies the holy damage dealt in PvP. 1: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Guard Stamina Damage Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplies the stamina a guarding player loses to the attack in PvP; a guard breaks when this reaches the player's current stamina. 1: unchanged. Retail: 1.25 on almost every row.

Fields.Name: Poise Damage Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplies the poise damage dealt in PvP. 1: unchanged.
